name: Chummy assistant
description: The default loop. It asks you a question first if your request is unclear. If the model can do it in one go, it does, with its result checked. Otherwise it makes the whole plan first (up to 10 specific steps, big steps planned again, two levels at most), then does the steps in order, each with up to 5 checked tries. Every tool call is checked before it runs, and the model keeps working notes. If a step fails all its tries, it says why and stops.

functions.name: Verify
functions.description: Writes a yes/no check question for an answer, then asks the model that question about it. Passed sends the answer on; Failed sends the reason. If a check can't run, the answer passes, so a failing model never blocks the work.

blocks.comment: A small model checks itself best with a question it wrote.

functions.name: Check the tool call
functions.description: Before a tool call runs, the model checks that it makes sense and is safe for the task. Approved calls go on to Run tool; others are declined with the reason, which goes back to the model. If the check can't run, the call is approved (your own approvals still apply).

functions.name: Do a step
functions.description: Up to 5 tries at a step, each with tools and a check. Each try sees what went wrong before. A step that passes is shown, ticked in the plan, added to {{results}}, and the notes are updated. A step that fails all 5 tries gets an explanation from the model, which is shown, and the run stops as failed.

functions.name: Write a plan
functions.description: The model writes up to 10 specific steps, then checks the plan (does it get there, is every step concrete, no needless tiny steps). A plan that fails its check is written again once, with the problem. The steps go into the plan outline under the task. Failed sends the error if the model call fails.

params.format:
_INPUT1_

Write a plan: the steps to do, in order. Rules:
- Use as few steps as the work needs (often 2 to 5, never more than 10). Don't split anything that can be done in one go.
- Make every step specific and concrete: say exactly what to do, with which files, names or values, and what it produces. No vague steps like "research the topic" or "finalize".
- Each step must make sense on its own, without reading the others.
Write only the steps, one per line, numbered like:
1. First step
2. Second step

functions.name: Plan a step
functions.description: The model says whether this step can be done in one go. If it can, the step is added to the steps to do ({{steps}}). If not, it gets its own plan of up to 10 steps, and those are added instead. A failed judgement or plan keeps the step as it is.

functions.name: Make the full plan
functions.description: Plans the goal in up to 10 steps, then goes through them in order: each step the model can't do in one go gets its own plan right away (depth first, at most two levels). Nothing is done yet. The steps to do end up in {{steps}}, one per line, and the outline in {{plan}}. Planned fires once, when all of it is finished.

blocks.label: Plan a step
blocks.comment: Runs once per step, finishing each (and its own plan) before the next: depth first.

blocks.label: Note the failure
blocks.comment: If planning fails, there are no steps and the goal is done as one step.

functions.name: Carry out the plan
functions.description: Does the steps to do one at a time, in order, each with Do a step. Finished fires once, after the last step. If a step fails all its tries, the run stops there.

blocks.label: Do a step
blocks.comment: Each step finishes (result, notes) before the next starts.

notes.text:
Chummy assistant

1. Clarify: one question to you if the request is unclear.
2. One go? If the model can do it all at once, it tries (twice at most, each result checked). If that fails, it plans.
3. Plan: the whole plan first, nothing done yet. Up to 10 specific steps, checked; each step too big for one go gets its own plan, depth first, two levels at most.
4. Carry out: each step in order, up to 5 tries, every tool call and result checked. A step that fails all 5 is explained, and the run stops.
5. Context: {{goal}}, {{plan}}, {{notes}} (rewritten by the model after the plan and each step) and {{results}}.
